fill: causal forward fill within last six observations; no target filling
point_forecast: sample median (average of two central order statistics for even sample count)
tuning: none; frozen pretrained weights; no fine-tuning; fixed patch8 for MOIRAI
MOIRAI_future: only target-time 5 easy values observed; first 5 future grid steps masked; no future chemicals
Timer_padding: normalize each window over available grid history; left pad to96 with normalized zero (window mean), explicit model length adaptation
Sundial_padding: normalize over available history; left pad to32 with normalized zero; revin=False to avoid including padding in statistics
unknown_padding: Chronos NaN; MOIRAI zero plus observed mask and past_is_pad
excluded_reason: Local versions do not natively accept the required future covariates; no training adapter or new weights requested.
forecast_setting: frozen-weight retrospective conditional forecast; history chemical measurements updated at every origin
input_verification: Future input perturbation and no-future ablation verified separately in 未来输入隔离核验.json
